result.instructions: Tools for ConvertAPI, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Convert this Word file to PDF."; "How many conversions do I have left this month?"; "Which formats can ConvertAPI turn into PNG, and what options does PDF to DOCX take?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes ConvertAPI data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run convertapi_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run convertapi_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run convertapi_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. convertapi_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: convertapi_get_account
tools.title: Get account and quota
tools.description: Show the ConvertAPI account status and conversion quota: Active, Status, ConversionsTotal, ConversionsConsumed, ConversionsLeft. Call this first to check quota before converting. Never returns the account secret. ConvertAPI: GET /user.

tools.name: convertapi_get_usage_statistics
tools.title: Get usage statistics
tools.description: Show conversions per day between two dates for this account, as JSON. Use it to report usage over a period. ConvertAPI: GET /user/statistic?startDate&endDate.

tools.name: convertapi_get_converter
tools.title: Get converter details
tools.description: Describe one conversion, for example pdf to docx: its title, the accepted source and destination formats, and the parameter names and types it takes. Read it before convert_file so the parameters are right. ConvertAPI: GET /info/openapi (catalog, filtered to one path).

from_format.description: File format without the dot, for example pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg.

to_format.description: File format without the dot, for example pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg.

tools.name: convertapi_convert_file
tools.title: Convert a file
tools.description: Convert a file from one format to another. The file must be at a public https URL that ConvertAPI can read; local files cannot be sent. Each successful conversion costs ConversionCost conversions from the account quota. Returns download URLs that stay valid for a few hours. ConvertAPI: POST /convert/{from}/to/{to} (multipart, File=URL, StoreFile=true).

from_format.description: File format without the dot, for example pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg.

to_format.description: File format without the dot, for example pdf, docx, xlsx, jpg.

file_url.description: Public https URL of the file to convert.

parameters.description: Conversion parameters by name, as strings, for example { PageSize: "A4" }. See convertapi_get_converter.
